selectedTrial.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather edit. Selective depth of field study for a painted children's book cave background.
Image 1 is the edit target. Preserve its exact composition and all objects: sweeping blue and teal cave wall arches, ochre-gold ground, low scattered blue rocks, pastel faceted crystals at lower-left edge and right edge, broad empty cave center. Same camera, framing, object locations, geometry, colors, light and gentle gouache brushwork. No words are currently on this background; do not add any.
Create a GENTLE, clearly perceptible shallow-depth-of-field treatment. The future character will be a separate sharp layer standing around x59%, feet y87% and head y29%. Establish focal plane around the mid/near floor where the character stands: keep central and lower-center golden floor, nearby small rocks around x45-75% y78-92%, and foot-contact area crisp with painted texture.
Gradually soften far blue cave wall and distant rock silhouettes behind the character, especially upper half and central background. Mild optical defocus, enough to make wall edges softer, not a washed-out fog. Closest extreme bottom-left crystal tips and bottom-right rock edge may be slightly softer, as nearer than focus plane. Preserve their recognizable shapes and facets. Smooth depth transitions, no obvious focus circle or cutout mask.
This is selective focus, not a uniform blur, not new atmospheric haze, not a repaint or restyle. Keep background painting recognizable, no added sparkle, vignette, contrast, saturation, rays or changed light source. No child, person, text, props or logos. Full opaque square image, ideally native 2048 x 2048.
selectedTrial.notes: Initial request said gentle. Output is a stronger focus treatment; Jeff selected this output for trial. No second variant generated.
